name: [RE]:boot | Echoes Linger in Lunar Dust
source:
Underneath the blood red moon, the city burns. And amidst the chaos of the world and your heart, you share one last conversation with the woman you love.

[From [url=https://elduator.itch.io/reboot-vn]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
血红色的月光下，城市在燃烧。在世界和内心的混乱之中，你与你所爱的女人进行了最后一次对话。

[来自[url=https://elduator.itch.io/reboot-vn]itch.io[/url]]
